preconditions.description: The root is either a TreeNode or None.

postconditions.description: The return value is a list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: All elements in the return list are integers.
The length of the return list is equal to the number of nodes in the tree.
The return list is the inorder traversal of the tree.
